name: Sudoku-Bench
intro: Sudoku-Bench 是评测创造性逻辑推理的数独变体基准，核心challenge_100覆盖15道4×4、15道6×6和70道9×9题，并以纯文本精确描述规则、棋盘和视觉约束。
build_method: 专家选题, SudokuPad导出, 纯文本规则与棋盘编码
eval_feature: 无工具, 多步交互与单轮求解, 首错即停
build_method_en: Expert puzzle selection, SudokuPad export, pure-text rule and board encoding
eval_feature_en: No tools, Multi-step interaction and single-shot solving, Stop on first error
intro_en: Sudoku-Bench evaluates creative logical reasoning over Sudoku variants. Its core challenge_100 contains fifteen 4x4, fifteen 6x6, and seventy 9x9 puzzles, with rules, boards, and visual constraints represented precisely in text.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Sudoku-Bench arXiv:2505.16135 Sections 2-4; official SakanaAI/Sudoku-Bench repository and challenge_100 release. Sudoku-Bench's core challenge_100 set selects 15 four-by-four, 15 six-by-six, and 70 nine-by-nine puzzles to span model capability. Fifty puzzles were curated exclusively by the Cracking the Cryptic hosts and twenty difficult vanilla puzzles were supplied by Nikoli. The collection is balanced from one- to five-star difficulty. Each puzzle is exported from SudokuPad into a pure-text specification containing the rules, grid size, initial digits, and coordinate descriptions of visual elements, isolating creative reasoning from visual parsing. The release also includes separate nikoli_100 and 2,565-item ctc subsets plus an expert-trace research asset built from more than 3,000 Cracking the Cryptic video transcripts and SudokuPad actions; these are not the core 100-puzzle score set. Evaluation is tool-free. In multi-step mode the model commits at least one digit, receives the updated board, and stops at the first wrong placement or after solving; the initial prompt and five latest responses remain in context. Single-shot mode requests the whole solution once. Average solve rate and, for multi-step, average correct placements are reported across one run per model and puzzle.
